title: MEIKO — A Challenging Spirit!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I'm glad that our camp turned out so nice♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Between the tarp we made from the stage curtains, the practice mats that we turned into beds and all this food, our camp looks spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, but... It's kinda too bad that we didn't have enough blankets to go around.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. Not even after taking some from the bed I use for when I take naps throughout the day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be fine then.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: MEIKO, thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, it's the plushies!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you ask something of them, MEIKO? Mind explaining for us?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We can be the bedding!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah! We're nice and fluffy, so we can lie down and become bedding for everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... Yes, you'd certainly make for some nice bedding. If anything, you'd be warm and cozy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they would. I might just take a nap with them right now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Was this also your idea, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it was!
I tried coming up with a workaround after Len mentioned that we may not have enough bedding!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, we just need to see if Tsukasa and the others are okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...! Did you guys feel that just now?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I felt it too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, our connection may be back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it might be!
Hello?! Tsukasa?! Everyone?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank goodness they were able to call for help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, they still get to do their show as ambassadors despite the change in schedule.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Same!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But we won't be able to go see their show...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There isn't a whole lot we can do about that since Emu and the others' phones are broken.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luckily, we were able to connect to Tsukasa's phone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it sounded like the hologram feature wasn't working properly, so his phone may also need fixing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh no. Doesn't that mean we won't be able to see them until their phones get fixed...? That's so sad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We'll just have to be a bit patient.
I'm sure they'll find a way to have them repaired in short order and visit us soon after.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on...
What should we do about our camp?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's no need for them to take shelter here anymore, so I guess we have to pack everything up now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not necessarily. We went through the trouble of setting all this up, so we should make use of it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Now I understand what you meant by finding a different use for our camp after realizing that they wouldn't need to take shelter here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That sounds lovely.
I think I'll start by taking a little nap on one of the beds made out of practice mats.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me three!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! I wanna try it too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! In that case, let's use everything we set up to have a little campout!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Plushies!
Wanna be my bedding?!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Sure, just lie down on that bed for us!
And... Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! The plushies are dogpiling on top of Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No fair...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Len, Rin, do you two also wanna give it a try? There's still lots and lots of us, so we're ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! I wanna try!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
I'm literally covered in plushies!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
They seem so nice and fluffy.
I might just ask them to do that for me next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I'll go after that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. You guys, that tickles...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. This is turning into a fun and lively campout already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is! It just goes to show that SEKAI needs to be full of smiles and laughter♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, let's join in on the fun!
